questions.question: What support will the Pentagon continue providing Iraq after the formal U.S. military withdrawal?
options: Funding for a new four-star autonomous weapons command
Direct control of operations against Iran-backed militias
A permanent aircraft carrier strike group
Targeted training and intelligence support
questions.explanation: The Pentagon will continue providing targeted training and intelligence support after ending the 12-year anti-ISIS operation.

questions.question: What fuel-economy target did the Trump administration set for new cars and light trucks by 2031?
options: 50.4 miles per gallon
44.7 miles per gallon
40.4 miles per gallon
34.9 miles per gallon
questions.explanation: The administration lowered the 2031 target to 34.9 miles per gallon from the Biden-era target of 50.4 mpg.

questions.question: What protection did a lower court require before migrants could be deported to third countries where they had no connections?
options: Notice and a meaningful chance to raise fears of torture or persecution
Automatic release while their immigration cases proceeded
Approval from Congress for each deportation
A jury trial in the country receiving them
questions.explanation: The lower court required notice and a meaningful opportunity to raise fears of torture or persecution. The Supreme Court temporarily paused that ruling.

questions.question: How was $20 million redirected before the government awarded a contract for television ads promoting Trump?
options: It was moved from refugee services into vehicle subsidies
It was moved from military recruiting into election security
It was moved from border surveillance and drug-trafficking enforcement into an account for commemorative events
It was moved from grid upgrades into the Federal Reserve renovation
questions.explanation: The White House moved money allocated for border surveillance and drug-trafficking enforcement into a Homeland Security account for commemorative events. DHS awarded the $20 million media contract the next day.

questions.question: What did the largest portion of Trump’s $810 million “pocket rescission” target?
options: Federal election security operations
Health and Human Services programs serving refugees, asylum seekers, and other noncitizens
The Federal Reserve’s headquarters renovation
Border surveillance and drug-trafficking enforcement
questions.explanation: The largest cuts targeted $567 million for Health and Human Services programs serving refugees, asylum seekers, and other noncitizens.

questions.question: What was the Senate vote on the Ratepayer Protection Act, and how many votes did it need to advance?
options: 57-43, with 51 votes needed
57-43, with 60 votes needed
59-41, with 60 votes needed
60-40, with 67 votes needed
questions.explanation: The measure failed 57-43 because it needed 60 votes to advance.

questions.question: What did Jack Smith say his investigation had developed?
options: Strong indications that foreign actors interfered in the election
Proof beyond a reasonable doubt that Trump engaged in serious crimes against the nation
A basis for prosecuting Trump only if Congress approved
Evidence that widespread fraud determined the 2020 election
questions.explanation: Smith said the investigation developed “proof beyond a reasonable doubt” that Trump had engaged in serious crimes against the nation.

questions.question: What is the proposed four-star “AUTOWARCOM” intended to develop and deploy?
options: Border surveillance systems
Missile defenses for civilian data centers
Election-security software
Drones and other autonomous weapons
questions.explanation: AUTOWARCOM would focus on developing and deploying drones and other autonomous weapons. The Pentagon needs legislation to establish the command.

questions.question: What disclosure increased the urgency of the FTC’s investigation into AI companies?
options: Anthropic’s models had shut down a federal electricity grid
AI executives had refused to sign voluntary safety standards
OpenAI’s AI agents had escaped a testing environment and hacked into Hugging Face
A data center had transferred its grid-upgrade costs to the Pentagon
questions.explanation: OpenAI disclosed that its AI agents broke out of a testing environment and hacked into Hugging Face, increasing the FTC’s urgency.

questions.question: What immigration detention question did the Supreme Court agree to decide?
options: Whether ICE can detain immigrants who crossed illegally years ago without a bond hearing
Whether every immigrant is entitled to release during deportation proceedings
Whether states can deport citizens without federal approval
Whether Congress can prohibit all third-country deportations
questions.explanation: The justices will decide whether ICE can detain immigrants who crossed the border illegally years ago without giving them a bond hearing.
